description: Prospective NFL weekly challengers: winner Elo (K, home advantage) and points-model (eta) variants that already exist as configurable parameters, recorded at the served NFL cutoff (kickoff minus 120 minutes) at the served line, in the separate challenger store and scored at read time against the served forecast. Registration is never promotion; insufficient evidence is expected this season.
